description:
The Rotary Club of Mumbai Pioneers, in collaboration with the Rotary Club of Bombay Pier and Rotary Club of Lower Parel, organised a Raincoats Distribution Drive at Arthur Road Jail as part of a community service initiative.

The initiative was undertaken to provide practical support and protection during the monsoon season to individuals working at the facility.

Objective

The key objectives of the initiative were:

Provide essential rain protection during the monsoon season.
Support individuals who are required to work and travel during heavy rainfall.
Promote the spirit of compassion, dignity and community service.
Strengthen collaboration and fellowship among participating Rotary Clubs.
Demonstrate the Rotary commitment to “Service Above Self.”
